content.value_statement: Designing decks and artifacts consistently can take time. Theme Factory applies curated color palettes and font pairings across slides, documents, reports, and pages.
actual_capabilities: Displays a theme-showcase PDF before theme selection.
Provides ten named preset themes with palettes and font pairings.
Reads theme specifications from the themes directory before applying styles.
Applies selected colors and fonts consistently to slides or artifacts.
Creates a custom theme when presets do not fit the artifact.
limitations: It does not modify the showcase PDF; it only displays it for review.
Preset themes cover visual styling only, not content strategy or copywriting.
It requires user confirmation before applying a selected theme.
Custom themes need user-provided context to choose suitable colors and fonts.

use_cases.title: Style Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply a polished palette and font pairing across a consulting deck before delivery.

use_cases.title: Refresh Product Launch Pages
use_cases.description: Choose a visual theme that supports a launch page, announcement, or product narrative.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Reports
use_cases.description: Give recurring reports a consistent look without rebuilding their layout from scratch.

prompt_templates.title: View Theme Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the theme showcase for this artifact. Ask which preset theme I want to apply before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Apply A Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this deck. Keep the existing content and improve color and typography consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend A Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this report and recommend the best preset theme for an executive audience. Explain the fit before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Custom Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a sustainable finance presentation. Propose colors, fonts, and use cases, then wait for approval.

output_examples.input: User asks to style a quarterly business review deck with Ocean Depths.
output_examples.output: The deck uses deep navy backgrounds, teal accents, seafoam highlights, cream text, and DejaVu Sans typography.

output_examples.input: User asks for a new theme for a sustainable wellness report.
output_examples.output: A custom theme is proposed with calming green accents, soft neutral backgrounds, and clean readable font pairing.

output_examples.input: User asks to choose a theme for a software launch page.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Tech Innovation and explains that its high-contrast palette suits product launches.

best_practices: Review the showcase PDF with stakeholders before applying a theme.
Confirm the target audience and tone before creating a custom theme.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors and fonts.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme before the user confirms the selection.
Mixing unrelated palettes across slides without a clear design reason.
Using a decorative theme when the artifact needs dense technical reading.

faq.question: What artifacts can Theme Factory style?
faq.answer: It can style slides, documents, reports, landing pages, and other visual artifacts that support colors and fonts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes, each with colors, font choices, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a custom theme from your audience, topic, brand, or preferred visual direction.

faq.question: Does it change the showcase PDF?
faq.answer: No. The skill displays the PDF for review and uses separate theme files for application.

faq.question: Does it work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users provide before applying a theme?
faq.answer: Users should provide the artifact, target audience, preferred tone, and any brand constraints.
